title: 拉扎德首席策略师：AI投入超7000亿美元，回报在哪？
speaker: Ron Temple

segments.en: So, I know that you amongst other people are really questioning when investors are going to want to see tangible investment returns on how much has been put into companies ranging from hyper-scalers to these chip producers, right?
segments.zh: 我知道您和其他人都在质疑，投资者何时才能看到投入的巨额资金带来实际回报？这些资金流向了超大规模云服务商和芯片制造商。

segments.en: If you take a look at the exuberance that was all with SK Hanukes debut in the US overnight, are those questions being asked now or are we just seeing this market being pushed higher?
segments.zh: 看看SK海力士在美国上市首日的狂热，现在市场是在问这些问题，还是只是被情绪推高？

segments.en: You know, it's interesting if you look back over the last four years, we've seen this kind of ongoing rotation. You might say, hyper-scalers, then at one point the market was in favor of the energy infrastructure that would be required to make this all happen. Then we had another shift back towards hyper-scalers and now more towards semiconductors.
segments.zh: 回顾过去四年，我们看到持续的轮动。先是超大规模云服务商，然后市场青睐能源基础设施，接着又回到云服务商，现在转向半导体。

segments.en: So, there have been different rotations or even a turn within the market, but I think one of the biggest concerns that's kind of lurking is trying to figure out how this all turns on to into returns on invested capital. In particular here, I'm thinking of the biggest customers of the companies like SK Hanukes, et cetera, in the hardware space, you know, typically described as the hyper-scalers themselves. We've got commitments in the United States of over $700 billion this year and CapEx from hyper-scalers.
segments.zh: 市场出现了不同轮动，但最大的隐忧是：这一切如何转化为投入资本的回报？尤其是SK海力士等硬件公司的大客户——超大规模云服务商。今年美国超大规模云服务商的资本开支承诺超过7000亿美元。

segments.en: And I guess the question from me and from many other investors increasingly is, what is the roadmap from these multi-hundred billion dollar per year investments to some kind of ROIC or return on invested capital down the road. And I'm increasingly worried that it's going to be difficult to deliver an attractive ROIC on these investments, especially on the American side of the equation.
segments.zh: 我和许多投资者越来越想问：从每年数千亿美元的投资到未来的投入资本回报率，路线图是什么？我越来越担心，这些投资很难产生有吸引力的回报，尤其是在美国这边。
